summary: Tested Phase 3: Parser-Specific Layout Handling. All 26 tests passed. Layout parser correctly extracts line items from invoice images using Tesseract OCR with spatial analysis. Row detection groups words by y-coordinate clustering. Column detection finds boundaries from header keywords. Vendor-specific parsers (Sysco, PFG, US Foods) work correctly with fallback to simple extraction when header is unreadable. API integration includes layout_parse in response and stores summary in database.

run_ocr.handles_empty_image: PASS - run_ocr() returns empty list for blank images

detect_rows.groups_by_y_coordinate: PASS - detect_rows() groups words into rows by y-coordinate clustering
detect_rows.sorts_left_to_right: PASS - Words within each row sorted left-to-right

detect_columns.standard_header_keywords: PASS - Detects columns when header has Description, Qty, Price, Total
detect_columns.infers_from_data: PASS - Infers columns from data alignment when no header present

is_separator_or_summary.does_not_filter_headers: PASS - Does NOT filter rows with multiple column keywords (Description Qty Price Total)
is_separator_or_summary.does_not_filter_data_rows: PASS - Does NOT filter normal data rows (Chicken Breast 5 10.00 50.00)

parse_invoice_layout.returns_correct_structure: PASS - Returns items, row_count, column_count, header_detected, parser_used, raw_rows
parse_invoice_layout.handles_empty_image: PASS - Returns empty result with parser_used='none (no_ocr_words)'

receipt_parser.extracts_items: PASS - simple_receipt document_type uses receipt_parser, extracts items

vendor_parsers.sysco_dark_header: PASS - Sysco parser extracts items even with dark header (falls back to simple extraction)
vendor_parsers.pfg_weight_based: PASS - PFG parser extracts items from weight-based invoice
vendor_parsers.usfoods: PASS - US Foods parser extracts items correctly

fallback_parser.structured_fallback: PASS - Falls back to _extract_items_simple when column detection fails

api_integration.layout_parse_in_response: PASS - POST /api/upload/extract includes layout_parse with parser_used, items, row_count, column_count, header_detected
api_integration.layout_parse_stored_in_db: PASS - layout_parse summary stored in uploaded_receipts collection

multiple_formats.format_1_columnar_header: PASS - Standard columnar invoice with header

no_column_mixing.columns_distinct: PASS - Columns have distinct boundaries with no significant overlap

helper_functions.row_text: PASS - Reconstructs text from row words preserving spacing
helper_functions.parse_number: PASS - Handles $, commas, and invalid input correctly
helper_functions.extract_line_items: PASS - Maps row cells to columns correctly

features_verified: 1. run_ocr() extracts words with bounding boxes from an image
2. detect_rows() groups words into correct rows by y-coordinate clustering
3. detect_columns() finds column boundaries from header keywords
4. Column detection works when header row has standard keywords (Description, Qty, Price, Total)
5. _is_separator_or_summary() correctly filters subtotal/tax/total rows but NOT header rows
6. _is_separator_or_summary() does NOT filter rows containing multiple column keywords
7. parse_invoice_layout() returns correct structure: items, row_count, column_count, header_detected, parser_used, raw_rows
8. Receipt parser (simple_receipt) extracts all items from informal receipt
9. Vendor Sysco parser correctly extracts items from columnar invoice with dark header background (uses fallback)
10. Vendor PFG parser correctly extracts items from weight-based invoice
11. Vendor US Foods parser correctly extracts items
12. Structured parser falls back to _extract_items_simple when column detection fails
13. Messy layout parser handles uneven spacing correctly
14. Layout parser gracefully handles images with no text (returns empty result)
15. Layout parse result is included in POST /api/upload/extract response
16. Layout parse summary is stored in uploaded_receipts collection
17. Works on at least 3 different invoice formats (columnar with header, simple receipt, no header inferred)
18. No mixing between columns - each field maps to correct column
critical_code_review_comments: layout_parser.py is well-structured with clear separation: OCR (run_ocr), row detection (detect_rows), column detection (detect_columns), item extraction (extract_line_items), vendor parsers (_parse_sysco, _parse_pfg, _parse_usfoods)
Row detection uses y-coordinate clustering with tolerance_ratio * median_height for grouping
Column detection scores rows by header keyword matches (score >= 2 required), falls back to _infer_columns_from_data
_is_separator_or_summary() correctly preserves header rows by checking for multiple column keywords (header_hits >= 2)
Vendor parsers have appropriate fallback: Sysco falls back to _extract_items_simple when header is unreadable (white-on-dark)
upload.py correctly integrates layout parsing at lines 414-431, stores summary in receipt_doc (lines 442-448), includes full result in response (lines 630-636)
Error handling is graceful - layout parsing failure is non-fatal (logged as warning)
seed_data_creation: Created synthetic invoice images using PIL with LiberationMono fonts for testing (no database seed data needed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 Layout Parser fully tested. Key functions: run_ocr() uses Tesseract with --psm 6 to get word-level bounding boxes. detect_rows() clusters words by y-coordinate (tolerance = 0.4 * median_height). detect_columns() finds header row by keyword scoring (score >= 2), falls back to _infer_columns_from_data. Vendor parsers: _parse_sysco (falls back to simple extraction for dark headers), _parse_pfg (weight-based), _parse_usfoods. _is_separator_or_summary() filters summary rows but preserves headers (header_hits >= 2). API response includes layout_parse with parser_used, items, row_count, column_count, header_detected. Test images created with PIL using LiberationMono fonts at /usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/.
